real_estate_intro_1: Izindlu nempahla kube yitshalomali elidume kakhulu amashumi eminyaka futhi ngokuvamile ibhekwa njengendawo yokugcina inani eqinile.
real_estate_intro_2: I-Bitcoin iyimali yedijithali eyasungulwa ngo-2009 futhi ibhekwa ngabaningi njengendawo yokugcina inani nokutshalomali.
real_estate_intro_3: Kodwa impahla yengokoqobo ihluke kanjani emali yedijithali efana ne-Bitcoin? Ake sibheke umehluko phakathi kwezinhlobo ezimbili zokutshalomali: I-Bitcoin & Izindlu Nempahla.
point_1_summary_1: I-Bitcoin ihamba noma kuphi emhlabeni ngokushesha. Izindlu nempahla zibekwe endaweni eyodwa futhi zisengozini yezimo zomnotho wendawo, ezepolitiki, nezemvelo.
point_2_summary_1: I-Bitcoin yahlukaniswa ngama-sats angu-100 million. Izindlu nempahla azikwazi ukuthengiswa ngokwengxenye — awukwazi ukuthengisa ikhishi kuphela noma uthenge uhhafu wegumbi lokulala.
point_3_summary_1: I-Bitcoin isebenza kunethiwekhi engacentralized engelawulwa muntu. Izindlu nempahla zilawulwa kakhulu — ukulinganisa indawo, ukulawulwa kwerenti, umthetho wokuphucwa, nokuthathwa kufaka phakathi.
point_4_summary_1: I-Bitcoin ayidingi ukulungiswa. Izindlu zidinga ukulungiswa, ukuvuselelwa, umshwalense, ukuphathwa kwempahla, nezinkinga zabaqashi.
point_5_summary_1: I-Bitcoin ayinazintela ezilandelayo — ukhokha intela yenzuzo kuphela uma uthengisa. Izindlu zikweleta intela yempahla yonyaka kungakhathaliseki ukuthi inomholo.
point_6_summary_1: I-Bitcoin, igcinwe ngendlela efanele, isinda emlilweni, ezikhukhuleni, nasekuzamazameni komhlaba. Izindlu zisengozini kuyo yonke inhlekelele, futhi umshwalense awumbozi konke.
point_7_summary_1: Yonke i-bitcoin iyafana futhi iyashintshana. Yonke impahla yendlu iyahluka, okwenza ukubeka intengo nokuqhathanisa kube nzima.
point_8_summary_1: I-Bitcoin ithengiswa emhlabeni 24/7 yinoma ubani onokuxhumana ne-inthanethi. Ukuthengiswa kwezindlu kulinganiselwe kubathengi bendawo futhi kungathatha izinyanga zokuqeda amaphepha.
real_estate_point_9: Ifaka isandla ekuguqulweni kwezindlu zibe yimali
point_9_summary_1: I-Bitcoin ivumela ubunini bomuntu ngamunye obuqondile noma ubani. Ukuthenga izindlu njengokutshalomali ngaphezu kwekhaya lakho elikhulu kuphakamisa amanani ezindlu, kunciphise ukukwazi ukuthenga, futhi kufaka isandla enkingeni yezindlu.
